fields.title: Specified metrology does not establish the smallest waviness target
fields.evidence: The proposed 0.1–0.3mm scan precision is 1.33–3.99 times the 0.0751mm end of the waviness requirement. No uncertainty budget, spatial sampling or frequency-band verification is supplied.
fields.proposed_fix: Choose and validate metrology for the actual wavelength and tolerance; retain separate gross dimple and short-wave waviness requirements.

claim: Specified metrology does not establish the smallest waviness target
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma. [047 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:7472c3f9ee41a250), [056 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:a6b49a9c06df2016).
